bottleneck_notes: The slowest clicks shared Desktop Runtime or Source heavy workbench mount paths.
The runtime surface was also constructing Source workspace JSX before branching; early return removed that wasted render path.
Native refresh calls were moved out of the initial click-to-paint window.
